newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain's Rato prefers Argentaria to be independent.
newsitem.headline: Spain's Rato prefers Argentaria to be independent.

text.p: Spain's Economy Minister Rodrigo Rato said on Tuesday in an interview published by the financial daily Gaceta de los Negocios that he would like Argentaria to remain independent after the sale of the remaining 25 percent state stake.
"We insist that Argentaria should be an independent project and we will do whatever is within our responsibility," Rato said.
But, he added, the administration can't avoid that third parties would make other decisions.
"The government, if there have been merger decisions, has to be informed.
"But at the end...these decisions have to be taken by the company' board," he said.
